item.title: Real or AI fake? Suspicious off-screen Shenmue 4 trailer sparks excited debate
item.description: Ys Net could be preparing a Shenmue 4 announcement possibly to coincide with The Game Awards next week, if a suspicious, off-screen, leaked trailer is to be believed. If it is, Shenmue 4 will apparently arrive in 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X. Read more

item.title: "I would appreciate it if you could pick it up again" Capcom schedules new Monster Hunter Wilds presentation as its director begs players to return to the game
item.description: It's been an unexpectedly rough year for Monster Hunter Wilds. The game, which many assumed would be a massive success after the juggernaut sales of Monster Hunter World, has floundered a little post-launch. Capcom has been eager to point the finger on various factors, such as the price of a PS5 being a high barrier to entry, but the fact remains that the game's sales are lagging behind the ageing Street Fighter 6 and Monster Hunter Rise's DLC. Read more

item.description: Bethesda's Todd Howard has shared his thoughts on the use of AI in video games, calling it a "tool" but one that can't replace human intention. Read more
